--- title: "One fight, two grades" subtitle: "Cited Feats grades each citation shown if the cited passage depicts the feat, stated if a character, narrator or guidebook asserts it. A grade describes the evidence cited for a claim, not the event itself." description: "Arthur Dayne's Tower of Joy fight is graded stated in the book and shown in the TV show, yet 15 of 16 hand-matched events have the same grade in both. Citation pairs from prose originals and their adaptations were found by word overlap and reviewed by hand. Built in R with ggplot2, patchwork and ggtext." date: "2026-11-09" author: - name: "Steven Ponce" url: "https://stevenponce.netlify.app" citation: url: "https://stevenponce.netlify.app/data_visualizations/TidyTuesday/2026/tt_2026_45.html" categories: ["TidyTuesday", "2026"] tags: [ "TidyTuesday", "Cited Feats", "Fictional Characters", "Evidence Grading", "Game of Thrones", "Provenance Diagram", "Paired Comparison", "Explainer", "Annotation", "patchwork", "ggtext", "ggplot2", "2026" ] image: "thumbnails/tt_2026_45.png" format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 5 code-link: true code-fold: true code-tools: true code-summary: "Show code" editor_options: chunk_output_type: inline execute: freeze: true cache: true error: false message: false warning: false eval: true --- ![Two-panel explainer titled One fight, two grades, showing that Cited Feats grades the evidence cited for a claim, not the event itself. Panel A is a branching diagram: one event, Arthur Dayne at the Tower of Joy, splits into two cited passages. The book passage, A Clash of Kings chapter 21, is Eddard's account told to Bran and is graded as stated; the Game of Thrones episode S06E03 depicts the fight and is graded as shown. Panel B is a ledger of 16 hand-matched events cited in both a prose original and its adaptation, across A Song of Ice and Fire, Overlord, and Solo Leveling. In 15 of 16, both citations have the same grade; only the Tower of Joy, highlighted in burgundy, differs. One partial match, Sebas Tian, is listed separately and not counted. Data: Cited Feats open data via TidyTuesday.](tt_2026_45.png){#fig-1} ### [**Steps to Create this Graphic**]{.mark} #### [1. Load Packages & Setup]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: load #| warning: false #| message: false #| results: "hide" ## 1. LOAD PACKAGES & SETUP ---- suppressPackageStartupMessages({ if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman") pacman::p_load( tidyverse, ggtext, showtext, scales, glue, ggview, patchwork, ragg, magick ) }) # Source utility functions suppressMessages(source(here::here("R/utils/fonts.R"))) source(here::here("R/utils/social_icons.R")) source(here::here("R/utils/image_utils.R")) source(here::here("R/themes/base_theme.R")) ``` ```` ::: #### [2. Read in the Data]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: read #| include: true #| eval: true #| warning: false ### |- figure settings ---- fig_w <- 12 fig_h <- 7.5 fig_dpi <- 320 ### |- fonts ---- setup_fonts() fonts <- get_font_families() title_family <- fonts$title_1 ## 2. READ IN THE DATA ---- ## Read every field as character with no NA tokens; restore numbers column by column. tt_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-11-10/" read_chr <- function(url) { read_csv(url, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), na = character(), show_col_types = FALSE) } citations_raw <- read_chr(paste0(tt_url, "fiction_citations.csv")) rankings_raw <- read_chr(paste0(tt_url, "fiction_rankings.csv")) ## Hand-reviewed pool, written by tt_2026_45_match_candidates.R: every word-overlap candidate ## pair (prose original vs adaptation) with its decision -- clean, partial or rejected. matches_path <- here::here("data/TidyTuesday/2026/tt_2026_45_matched_events.csv") matches_raw <- read_chr(matches_path) ``` ```` ::: #### [3. Examine the Data]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: examine #| include: true #| eval: true #| results: 'hide' #| warning: false ## 3. EXAMINING THE DATA ---- glimpse(citations_raw) glimpse(matches_raw) citations_raw |> count(type, confidence) |> print(n = Inf) ``` ```` ::: #### [4. Tidy Data]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: tidy #| warning: false ### |- base rates quoted in copy ---- n_citations <- nrow(citations_raw) n_scaled <- sum(citations_raw$confidence == "scaled") ### |- look up each side of every matched pair in the citations ---- ## A side matches when franchise, character, type and locator agree exactly and the ## citation's claim starts with the recorded opening; exactly one citation must match. lookup_side <- function(slug, entry, type_wanted, loc, claim_start) { hit <- citations_raw |> filter( franchise_slug == slug, subject_id == entry, subject_kind == "entry", type == type_wanted, locator == loc, str_starts(claim, fixed(claim_start)) ) if (nrow(hit) != 1) stop(glue("{entry} / {loc}: {nrow(hit)} citations matched, expected 1")) hit |> select(work, confidence, claim) } n_reviewed <- nrow(matches_raw) n_rejected <- sum(matches_raw$match == "rejected") pairs <- matches_raw |> filter(match != "rejected") |> mutate( prose = pmap(list(franchise_slug, entry_id, "novel", prose_locator, prose_claim_start), lookup_side), adapt = pmap(list(franchise_slug, entry_id, adapt_type, adapt_locator, adapt_claim_start), lookup_side) ) |> unnest_wider(prose, names_sep = "_") |> unnest_wider(adapt, names_sep = "_") |> left_join( rankings_raw |> select(franchise_slug, entry_id, name, franchise), by = c("franchise_slug", "entry_id") ) |> mutate(changed = prose_confidence != adapt_confidence) clean_pairs <- pairs |> filter(match == "clean") n_clean <- nrow(clean_pairs) n_changed <- sum(clean_pairs$changed) n_same <- n_clean - n_changed n_partial <- sum(pairs$match == "partial") ### |- Panel A: the one clean pair whose grade changes ---- hero <- clean_pairs |> filter(changed) stopifnot(nrow(hero) == 1, hero$entry_id == "arthur-dayne", hero$event_label == "Tower of Joy") ### |- Panel B: row layout, franchise groups with a header row each ---- franchise_order <- c("westeros", "overlord", "solo-leveling") franchise_head <- c( westeros = "A Song of Ice and Fire / Game of Thrones", overlord = "Overlord light novels / anime", `solo-leveling` = "Solo Leveling web novel / webtoon" ) ledger <- clean_pairs |> mutate(franchise_slug = factor(franchise_slug, levels = franchise_order)) |> arrange(franchise_slug, name, event_label) |> mutate(row = row_number()) ## y positions: one slot per row, plus one header slot (and a small gap) per franchise row_step <- 1 ledger <- ledger |> mutate( group_idx = as.integer(franchise_slug), y = -(row + group_idx * 1.25) * row_step ) group_heads <- ledger |> summarise(y = max(y) + 1.05 * row_step, .by = franchise_slug) |> mutate(label = franchise_head[as.character(franchise_slug)]) partial_row <- pairs |> filter(match == "partial") |> mutate(y = min(ledger$y) - 2.1 * row_step) ``` ```` ::: #### [5. Visualization Parameters]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: params #| include: true #| warning: false ### |- plot aesthetics ---- clrs <- get_theme_colors( palette = list( accent = "#722F37", ink = "#2C2825", shown = "#5E5650", stated = "#FFFFFF", rule = "#D9D3C9", muted = "#7A7068", card = "#FFFFFF" ) ) col_accent <- clrs$palette$accent col_ink <- clrs$palette$ink col_shown <- clrs$palette$shown col_stated <- clrs$palette$stated col_rule <- clrs$palette$rule col_muted <- clrs$palette$muted col_card <- clrs$palette$card ### |- titles and caption ---- title_text <- "One fight, two grades" subtitle_text <- glue( "Cited Feats grades each citation **shown** if the cited passage depicts the feat, ", "**stated** if a character, narrator or guidebook asserts it.
", "A grade describes the evidence cited for a claim, not the event itself." ) cue_a <- "The event is the same; the cited passages are not. The book passage is Eddard's\naccount, told to Bran; the show's is Bran's vision of the fight itself." head_b <- glue("B {n_same} of {n_clean} hand-matched events keep the same grade") cue_b <- glue( "Events cited from both a prose original and its adaptation, found by word overlap within each\n", "character's citations and checked by hand; not every event the site cites twice." ) caption_lines <- c( glue( "Claim text is Cited Feats' own summary of each cited passage. {n_reviewed} word-overlap candidates from the three franchises cited in both ", "a prose original and its adaptation were read by hand: {n_clean} same event, {n_partial} partial, {n_rejected} different events." ), glue( "The site's third grade, scaled (inferred by comparison), appears in {n_scaled} of {comma(n_citations)} citations. ", "Data snapshot 2026-10-10; the live site has changed since." ) ) caption_text <- paste0( caption_lines[1], "
", caption_lines[2], "
", create_social_caption( tt_year = 2026, tt_week = 45, source_text = "Cited Feats open data (CC BY 4.0) via TidyTuesday" ) ) ### |- plot theme ---- base_theme <- create_base_theme(clrs) weekly_theme <- extend_weekly_theme( base_theme, theme( plot.title = element_textbox_simple( face = "bold", family = title_family, size = 30, color = col_ink, lineheight = 1.0, margin = margin(b = 12) ), plot.subtitle = element_textbox_simple( family = fonts$subtitle, size = 11.5, color = col_ink, lineheight = 1.3, margin = margin(b = 10) ), plot.caption = element_textbox_simple( family = fonts$caption, size = 6.6, color = col_muted, lineheight = 1.35, margin = margin(t = 10) ), axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(14, 20, 8, 20) ) ) theme_set(weekly_theme) ``` ```` ::: #### [6. Plot]{.smallcaps} ::: {.cell} ````{.cell-code} ```{{r}} #| label: plot #| warning: false ### |- grade chip helper (shared by both panels) ---- chip_layer <- function(df, x, y, grade, w, h, size, border, lw) { list( geom_tile( data = df, aes(x = {{ x }}, y = {{ y }}), width = w, height = h, fill = if_else(pull(df, {{ grade }}) == "shown", col_shown, col_stated), color = border, linewidth = lw ), geom_text( data = df, aes(x = {{ x }}, y = {{ y }}, label = str_to_upper({{ grade }})), family = fonts$text, fontface = "bold", size = size, color = if_else(pull(df, {{ grade }}) == "shown", "white", col_ink) ) ) } ### |- panel A: one event, two cited passages ---- cards <- tibble( side = c("prose", "adapt"), x = c(0.245, 0.755), head = c("PROSE ORIGINAL", "ADAPTATION"), source = c( glue("{hero$prose_work}\n{hero$prose_locator}"), glue("{hero$adapt_work}\n{hero$adapt_locator}") ), claim = c(str_wrap(hero$prose_claim, 30), str_wrap(hero$adapt_claim, 30)), grade = c(hero$prose_confidence, hero$adapt_confidence) ) card_w <- 0.47 card_bottom <- 0.02 card_top <- 0.66 p_a <- ggplot() + # panel heading and decoding cue annotate("text", x = 0, y = 1.00, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, family = fonts$text, size = 3.6, fontface = "bold", color = col_ink, label = "A One event, two cited passages" ) + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.945, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, family = fonts$text, size = 2.9, color = col_muted, lineheight = 1.15, label = cue_a ) + # the event annotate("rect", xmin = 0.22, xmax = 0.78, ymin = 0.765, ymax = 0.835, fill = col_card, color = col_ink, linewidth = 0.4 ) + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.80, family = fonts$text, size = 3.6, fontface = "bold", color = col_ink, label = glue("{hero$name} at the {hero$event_label}") ) + # the branch: the accent marks the change, not a grade annotate("segment", x = 0.5, xend = 0.5, y = 0.765, yend = 0.715, color = col_accent, linewidth = 0.9) + annotate("segment", x = 0.245, xend = 0.755, y = 0.715, yend = 0.715, color = col_accent, linewidth = 0.9) + annotate("segment", x = 0.245, xend = 0.245, y = 0.715, yend = card_top, color = col_accent, linewidth = 0.9) + annotate("segment", x = 0.755, xend = 0.755, y = 0.715, yend = card_top, color = col_accent, linewidth = 0.9) + # the two cards geom_rect( data = cards, aes(xmin = x - card_w / 2, xmax = x + card_w / 2, ymin = card_bottom, ymax = card_top), fill = col_card, color = col_rule, linewidth = 0.5 ) + geom_text( data = cards, aes(x = x - card_w / 2 + 0.03, y = card_top - 0.035, label = head), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, family = fonts$text, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", color = col_muted ) + geom_text( data = cards, aes(x = x - card_w / 2 + 0.03, y = card_top - 0.085, label = source), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, family = fonts$text, size = 3.1, color = col_ink, lineheight = 1.1 ) + geom_text( data = cards, aes(x = x - card_w / 2 + 0.03, y = card_top - 0.215, label = claim), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, family = fonts$text, size = 2.75, fontface = "italic", color = col_muted, lineheight = 1.2 ) + chip_layer( cards |> mutate(cy = card_bottom + 0.075), x, cy, grade, w = 0.30, h = 0.075, size = 4.2, border = col_ink, lw = 0.5 ) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(0)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(0)) + coord_cartesian(clip = "off") ### |- panel B: the whole reviewed pool ---- x_name <- 0.025 x_event <- 0.27 x_prose <- 0.70 x_adapt <- 0.89 chip_w <- 0.15 chip_h <- 0.72 y_top <- max(group_heads$y) + 1.9 p_b <- ggplot() + # panel heading and decoding cue annotate("text", x = 0, y = y_top + 2.5, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, family = fonts$text, size = 3.6, fontface = "bold", color = col_ink, label = head_b ) + annotate("text", x = 0, y = y_top + 1.5, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, family = fonts$text, size = 2.9, color = col_muted, lineheight = 1.15, label = cue_b ) + # column headers annotate("text", x = c(x_prose, x_adapt), y = y_top - 0.55, label = c("PROSE ORIGINAL", "ADAPTATION"), family = fonts$text, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", color = col_muted ) + # franchise group headers geom_text( data = group_heads, aes(x = 0, y = y, label = label), hjust = 0, family = fonts$caption, size = 2.4, color = col_muted ) + # rows: name and event geom_text( data = ledger, aes(x = x_name, y = y, label = name), hjust = 0, family = fonts$text, size = 2.9, fontface = if_else(ledger$changed, "bold", "plain"), color = if_else(ledger$changed, col_accent, col_ink) ) + geom_text( data = ledger, aes(x = x_event, y = y, label = event_label), hjust = 0, family = fonts$text, size = 2.9, fontface = if_else(ledger$changed, "bold", "plain"), color = if_else(ledger$changed, col_accent, col_muted) ) + # connector between the two grades geom_segment( data = ledger, aes(x = x_prose + chip_w / 2, xend = x_adapt - chip_w / 2, y = y, yend = y), color = if_else(ledger$changed, col_accent, col_rule), linewidth = if_else(ledger$changed, 0.9, 0.35) ) + chip_layer( ledger, x_prose, y, prose_confidence, w = chip_w, h = chip_h, size = 2.3, border = if_else(ledger$changed, col_accent, col_shown), lw = if_else(ledger$changed, 0.9, 0.3) ) + chip_layer( ledger, x_adapt, y, adapt_confidence, w = chip_w, h = chip_h, size = 2.3, border = if_else(ledger$changed, col_accent, col_shown), lw = if_else(ledger$changed, 0.9, 0.3) ) + # partial match, outside the count annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = 1, y = partial_row$y + 1.15, yend = partial_row$y + 1.15, color = col_rule, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "22" ) + annotate("text", x = 0, y = partial_row$y + 0.6, hjust = 0, family = fonts$caption, size = 2.4, color = col_muted, label = "Partial match, not counted" ) + geom_text( data = partial_row, aes(x = x_name, y = y - 0.25, label = name), hjust = 0, family = fonts$text, size = 2.9, fontface = "italic", color = col_muted ) + geom_text( data = partial_row, aes(x = x_event, y = y - 0.25, label = event_label), hjust = 0, family = fonts$text, size = 2.9, fontface = "italic", color = col_muted ) + chip_layer( partial_row |> mutate(y = y - 0.25), x_prose, y, prose_confidence, w = chip_w, h = chip_h, size = 2.3, border = col_shown, lw = 0.3 ) + chip_layer( partial_row |> mutate(y = y - 0.25), x_adapt, y, adapt_confidence, w = chip_w, h = chip_h, size = 2.3, border = col_shown, lw = 0.3 ) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(0)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(partial_row$y - 1, y_top + 2.6), expand = expansion(0)) + coord_cartesian(clip = "off") ### |- combine ---- p <- p_a + p_b + plot_layout(widths = c(0.82, 1.18)) + plot_annotation( title = title_text, subtitle = subtitle_text, caption = caption_text, theme = weekly_theme ) ``` ```` ::: ### [7.
